title: Dévissage des complexes ½ simpliciaux ∂ - parfaits et structures multiplicatives… (1975 ou 1976) : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting. C is a k-linear abelian or exact category, presumably a model for the category of ∂-perfect half-simplicial (semi-simplicial) complexes studied in this cote. It contains two families of objects: the Ψ^i (i≥0) and the 𝔏(i,n) (n≥1). There are non-split short exact sequences 0→Ψ^{i-1}→𝔏(i,n)→Ψ^i→0 with extension class e_{i,n}≠0. Earlier pages give Hom(Ψ^i,Ψ^j)=k for i=j and 0 otherwise. The previous page computed Hom(𝔏(i,-),Ψ^j): it is k for j=i, generated by the canonical surjection, and 0 otherwise.

This page computes Hom(Ψ^i,𝔏(j,n)). Apply Hom(Ψ^i,-) to 0→Ψ^{j-1}→𝔏(j,n)→Ψ^j→0. This gives a left-exact sequence 0→Hom(Ψ^i,Ψ^{j-1})→Hom(Ψ^i,𝔏(j,n))→Hom(Ψ^i,Ψ^j).

(1) Case j≠i. The right term is 0, so Hom(Ψ^i,𝔏(j,n))≅Hom(Ψ^i,Ψ^{j-1}). This vanishes unless j-1=i. For j=i+1 it is k, spanned by the canonical inclusion Ψ^i→𝔏(i+1,n).

(2) Case j=i. Take u:Ψ^i→𝔏(i,n). The composite Ψ^i→𝔏(i,n)→Ψ^i equals d·id for some scalar d∈k. Since u lifts d·id, the pullback of the extension along d·id splits. The pullback has class d·e_{i,n}, so d·e_{i,n}=0. Because e_{i,n}≠0 and k is a field, d=0. Then u factors through Ψ^{i-1}, i.e. lies in Hom(Ψ^i,Ψ^{i-1})=0, so u=0.

Conclusion: Hom(Ψ^i,𝔏(j,n)) is 0 for j≠i+1 and k for j=i+1, with basis the canonical map Ψ^i→𝔏(i+1,n).

Axiom (d). Every object of C is a finite iterated extension of objects 𝔏(i,n) (n≥1) or Ψ^j (j≥0). The next page draws the consequence: the full subcategory A on these generators, with its (half-)additive structure and composition, determines C up to equivalence.

Purpose. This is a dévissage/recognition step. The goal is to characterise the category of ∂-perfect half-simplicial complexes axiomatically, by the Hom-pattern between a small family of generators. It is akin to presenting a category by a quiver with relations of type A_∞, the Ψ^i forming an ordered, exceptional-like sequence.
errors: Step (2) needs k to be a field (or e_{i,n} non-torsion) and e_{i,n}≠0. Both are implicit, presumably earlier axioms, and are not restated.

In the factorisation step the transcription writes 'Ψ^i → Ψ^{i-1}'. Logically u factors through the subobject Ψ^{i-1}⊂𝔏(i,n), giving an element of Hom(Ψ^i,Ψ^{i-1})=0. This matches, but the wording is compressed.
The page does not show that the 'canonical homomorphism' Ψ^i→𝔏(i+1,n) is independent of n up to scalar. It is the inclusion of the sub in the defining extension, so this is harmless.

ideas.what: Computation of Hom from Ψ^i into the extension objects 𝔏(j,n) via the left-exact Hom sequence and the pulled-back extension class (d·e=0 ⇒ d=0)
ideas.modern_name: Elementary Ext/Hom computation in a length category; Hom-orthogonality for an exceptional-type sequence

ideas.what: Axiom (d): every object is a finite iterated extension of the generators 𝔏(i,n), Ψ^j, so C is recovered from the full subcategory A of generators
ideas.modern_name: Recognition of a category by a generating family / quiver-with-relations presentation; dévissage
ideas.usually_credited_to: Gabriel, Mitchell (reconstruction of abelian categories from generators); folklore

deep.surprise_reason: The page is a routine Hom computation in a k-linear category with an extension structure, plus a generation axiom. It is correct modulo implicit hypotheses and serves a larger, unpublished characterisation of ∂-perfect half-simplicial complexes. The page itself contains nothing a specialist would find new.
transcription_corrections: First line: 'Ψ^i_α' is Ψ^i with a marginal '∀α' added; the intended statement is Hom(Ψ^i,𝔏(j,n))→Hom(Ψ^i,Ψ^j), the latter being 0 if j≠i.
'h si j=i+1' should read 'k si j=i+1' (the base field), 'base formée de l'homomorphisme canonique Ψ^i→𝔏(i+1,n)'.

'le complexe Ψ^i ≃ 𝔏(i,n) ≃ Ψ / Ψ^i est de C formé de id Ψ^i' likely reads: 'Pour j=i, le composé Ψ^i → 𝔏(i,n) → Ψ^i est de la forme d·id_{Ψ^i}, donc l'image inverse de l'extension 𝔏(i,n) est de classe d·e_{i,n}, qui est nulle, donc d=0, donc u se factorise par Ψ^{i-1}, donc est nul.'
The diagram line should be '→Ψ^{i-1}→𝔏(i,n)→Ψ^i→0' with the map u (not α_j) from Ψ^i.
